generator: box (gltf-transform 4 + meshoptimizer), package 36-truck-switcher-v0.1; sources read-only from Drive packages 30.4 and 35

hosting.status: PUBLISHED: public repo DARYLHUFF/stinger-garage-trucks, tag v0.1 (2026-10-05). Build still keeps the packaged fallback for the default rig in case the CDN is unreachable.
hosting.jsdelivr_limits: 20 MB per file (all parts below are under 20 MB); 50 MB limit applies only to directory listings, not file links.

conventions.frame: glTF Y-up, front of tractor = -Z, ground (tyre contact) at y=0 - identical to the live default hauler
conventions.composition: A rig is two GLBs (tractor + trailer) loaded and parented under one group named Hauler_<id>. Each part already contains its own Hauler_<...> root node; adopt its children (the SCSRoot_* nodes) into the rig group. World transforms are baked so root_offset_m is [0,0,0] for every v0.1 rig.

canonical_roots.note: Same names the live app's unit-splitter (Unit_tractor / Unit_trailer, presentation gap) already looks for.

loader_requirements: KHR_mesh_quantization (normals int8; positions are untouched float32)
conventions.compression: meshopt FILTER bitstream only: no reorder, no position quantization, node TRS unchanged. Default-rig parts were checked node-by-node against the 30.4 source: 756/756 nodes, max world-position/bbox difference 0 m.

world_alignment.rule: Every rig is baked so its tractor fifth wheel and trailer kingpin sit at z = 4.263 (the default's coupled hook2). The garage floor, world origin and lot origin do not move when rigs change. The display gap between units is still applied at runtime by the existing presentation shift; it is not baked in.

trucks.label: Peterbilt 389 + Cottrell headrack + CX09 LSFA
trucks.status: PROVISIONAL_ASSEMBLY (box-assembled from package 35 GLBs; not reviewed in Blender)

tractor.contents: p389_truck_chassis_cabin + p389_cottrell_headrack (the headrack is already seated on the 389 cottrell locator) + PROVISIONAL tyres
tractor.cab_root_note: The package 35 export merges cab and chassis into one mesh set. Everything sits under SCSRoot_tractor_chassis; SCSRoot_tractor_cabin is an empty marker.

trailer.body_root_note: Body and chassis are merged in the package 35 export. Everything sits under SCSRoot_trailer_chassis; SCSRoot_trailer_body is an empty marker.

source.tyre_meshes: cloned from the default 30.4 hauler (wheel_f_0_0/1_0, wheel_r_0_0/1_0)
source.mod: Peterbilt 389 Auto Hauler v1.5 by F3D Modding (ATS)

coupling.source: SCS hook_t_bc (truck) and hook2 (trailer) locators from package 35 convert_p389.json

deck_anchors.note: Run the same slot table and height probes on this geometry. If a slot probe returns nothing, use the default rig's resolved slot (as a fraction of unit length, plus height) and mark the slot FALLBACK in the UI and the scenario JSON.

mechanisms.note: No Mech_/PROVISIONAL_HeadRack_* nodes exist. Show deck/ramp motion controls disabled, with the note 'Static model - motion not rigged for this rig'.

flags: UNCALIBRATED stock SCS proportions: the trailer is about 0.8 m longer and the CX09 tandem sits about 3.3 m further back than Daryl's corrected default trailer
tyres are PROVISIONAL clones of the default T660 drive/steer tyres at the SCS wheel locators. Track widths were copied from the default because the SCS x offsets were not recorded
fifth-wheel height 0.288 m vs default 0.546 m: the coupling is self-consistent within this rig, but lower than the default
Daryl's cab photo shows a Peterbilt badge (directive 1.5). This rig may be closer to his real tractor, but the exact model is unconfirmed
